lines.english: Glory to God in the highest.

lines.latin: Et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis.
lines.english: And on earth peace to men of good will.

lines.latin: Grátias ágimus tibi propter magnam glóriam tuam.
lines.english: We give Thee thanks for Thy great glory.

lines.latin: Dómine Deus, Rex cæléstis, Deus Pater omnípotens.
lines.english: O Lord God, heavenly King, God the Father almighty.
O Lord Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son.

lines.latin: Dómine Deus, Agnus Dei, Fílius Patris.
lines.english: O Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father.

lines.latin: Qui tollis peccáta mundi, miserére nobis.
lines.english: Who takest away the sins of the world, have mercy on us.

lines.latin: Qui tollis peccáta mundi, súscipe deprecatiónem nostram.
lines.english: Who takest away the sins of the world, receive our prayer.

lines.latin: Qui sedes ad déxteram Patris, miserére nobis.
lines.english: Who sittest at the right hand of the Father, have mercy on us.
Thou alone, O Jesus Christ, art most high,

lines.latin: Cum Sancto Spíritu, in glória Dei Patris. Amen.
lines.english: with the Holy Ghost, in the glory of God the Father. Amen.
